scope: Evidence-only corrections after all three review layers completed; no target rerun, no change to sealed execution or earlier approval bytes.

findings.claim: Final post-receipt verification remains only in /tmp, outside the sealed packet.
findings.evidence: The manifest has 417 files and no final-verification.json. The original capture directory retains that actual observation at 2026-10-26T15:58:42.881201+00:00, binding the unchanged receipt/archive/manifest and zero survivors.
findings.fix: Preserve the existing final-verification.json bytes in a separately bound supplement; do not reconstruct the observation or reseal the original packet.

findings.claim: postRecordingMetadataEqual names a later boundary than the captured certificate observation.
findings.evidence: certificate-post-seal-metadata.json is timestamped 15:58:31.506310Z, before archive verification at 15:58:42.509137Z and receipt creation. The metadata comparison is after target execution and before sealing completed.
findings.fix: Add a field-specific correction narrowing the boundary to the captured timestamp; preserve raw labels and bytes.

findings.claim: The outer invocation observer overstates process-group coverage.
findings.evidence: invoke_once.py builds the sampled set by recursive ppid traversal and checks previously seen PID/startTime identities at its end. It does not union every process in the outer process group. The separate inner driver and later seal observer do check owned sandbox groups.
findings.fix: Distinguish outer ancestry sampling/seen-identity check from inner sandbox group observations, including their limits.

findings.claim: Certificate contentsRead/storeEdits claims need an explicit collector subject.
findings.evidence: The collector uses lstat metadata only; sandbox targets can read the real home mounted read-only. No file-access trace proves that SDK or implicit initializers never read stores. Equal recorded metadata does not prove every possible read or external-state nonchange.
findings.fix: Scope no-read/no-hash/no-edit assertions to collection code and report observed metadata equality; explicitly retain unobserved target reads.

findings.claim: Independent historical regular-file metadata preservation is not supported by the persisted manifest.
findings.evidence: seal_evidence.py compares full inventories before and after archival in memory, but writes regular-file path/size/hash only. Directory metadata is persisted; historical regular-file mode/uid/gid/mtimeNs/ctimeNs snapshots are not. Tar headers alone cannot reconstruct that source comparison.
findings.fix: Narrow sourceMembershipAndMetadataUnchanged to the collector-reported intra-seal assertion; distinguish independently checked contents from unretained metadata snapshots. Do not invent historical metadata.

findings.claim: The outer adapter's approved bytes are not portable within the execution archive.
findings.evidence: The 417-member manifest has the private driver and wrappers but not execute_after_filter_reset_authorization.py. The approved adapter still exists unchanged at the plan-bound repository path with SHA256 1b3aeb881751e469d3407a4f9614b3ec715b91244cd380fb9ca3bce5322d0618.
findings.fix: Copy those exact approved adapter bytes into the supplement and bind their original source/path/hash; do not invoke them.

findings.claim: Inherited package-layout anomalies need explicit disclosure as untested seams.
findings.evidence: The signed candidate nupkg itself contains g4-host/cs/cs/Aspire.Hosting.resources.dll and g4-host/runtimes/linux-x64/native/runtimes/linux-x64/native/libhex1binterop.so. The ordinary g4-host/runtimes/linux-x64/native/libhex1binterop.so is absent; host deps names runtimes/linux-x64/native/libhex1binterop.so. No affected native/satellite load was exercised.
findings.fix: Disclose inherited layout observations and qualification limits; do not infer runtime failure, choose a package repair, or broaden authorization.

findings.claim: The cold-case report can describe captured binding state more precisely.
findings.evidence: The cold context initiallyLoaded list contains no Hexalith.EventStore assembly, while TPA maps Hexalith.EventStore.Aspire.dll to host. No EventStore.Aspire assembly-load event appears in cold before the final failure; host-first has the explicit 3.127 event. These are recorded observations, not proof of all native binder internals or ordinary JIT order.
findings.fix: State the captured initial/event/TPA distinction without equating a host mapping with an already loaded assembly.

findings.claim: Inherited conclusions need direct links to their governing evidence.
findings.evidence: The report currently links only the execution receipt, although the immutable original plan, new approval, compile/reference result, selected catalog qualification and owner-intake/composition records all exist.
findings.fix: Add exact relative links to governing plans/approvals and reused evidence; retain their prior limitations.

findings.claim: The packet needs portable read-only verification instructions.
findings.evidence: seal_evidence.py mutates recording outputs and depends on private source trees, so it is unsuitable for portable verification of the completed packet. No standalone read-only verifier is currently supplied.
findings.fix: Supply a read-only Python verifier for fixed receipt/archive/manifest SHA256 values and all unique safe regular-file members/sizes/hashes. No extraction, writes, subprocesses or target commands.
